assays.assay_description: Mice (10/group) were orally pretreated with compound 13 (0.03–1.0 mg/kg), risperidone, aripiprazole, or vehicle 60 min before i.p. DOI (1 mg/kg). Immediately after DOI, mice were placed individually into observation chambers; after a 5-min wait, head-twitch responses were counted for 15 min.

application_type.evidence: compound 13 administered p.o.; DOI administered i.p.

setup_restrain.evidence: animals were individually placed into observation chambers

food_restriction.evidence: Food not present in observation chambers during the head-twitch recording.

water_restriction.evidence: Water not present in observation chambers during the head-twitch recording.

time_to_assay.evidence: Immediately after DOI treatment, animals were individually placed into observation chambers; after a 5-min wait, the number of head twitch responses that occurred during the next 15 min was counted.

sample_size.evidence: Mice (10 mice in each group) were orally dosed with increasing doses of the aripiprazole ... risperidone ... compound 13 ... or vehicle

outcomes.summary: DOI (1 mg/kg, i.p.) induced head-twitch responses in mice, which were suppressed by oral pretreatment with compound 13 in a dose-dependent manner (ED50 = 0.07 mg/kg). Risperidone (ED50 0.04) and aripiprazole (ED50 0.58 mg/kg) also reduced head twitches.
outcomes.statistics: ED50 compound 13 = 0.07 mg/kg; two-way ANOVA followed by Tukey post-hoc; #p<0.05 vs vehicle; **p<0.01, *p<0.05 vs DOI treatment
outcomes.evidence: DOI caused head twitch responses in mice, which were suppressed by pretreatment with compound 13 in a dose-dependent manner (ED50, 0.07 mg/kg)

judge_notes: Only the DOI-induced head-twitch assay involves administration of a psychedelic (DOI). All other in vivo assays in the paper (APO-climbing, MK-801 hyperactivity, FST, TST, NOR, catalepsy, locomotor activity, weight gain, prolactin, PK) test the novel antipsychotic compound 13 without psychedelic administration and are out of scope per rubric.
Session duration scored as 15–60 min based on the 15-min recording window (B/glm scored <15 min, but rubric treats 15 min inclusive as the 15–60 bin).
Group housing scored 'no' based on explicit statement that animals were 'each kept in a separate cage'.
application_type set to 'multiple' because compound 13 was given p.o. and DOI i.p. in the same assay.
